time_base_note: REJECTED FIXTURE. The second event carries an offset and does not say where the offset came from. A run log exists to put every event on one timeline and to say which of those times a physical value may depend on (4.6.9); an offset with no time_base answers the first and silently drops the second, so a software offset carrying OS jitter becomes indistinguishable from a trigger count. Check 1 refuses it against run_log.schema.json.
